evals.prompt: I have a FastAPI + Celery + Postgres repo at ~/work/order-bot. Docs are only a 400-line README. Create an agent wiki like wiki_mjauto — scaffold first, English, folder wiki_orderbot, add to gitignore, draft cursor rule but don't install.
evals.expected_output: Full wiki_orderbot/ tree with L0-L4 stubs, 5-8 domains (api, workers, database, infra, etc.), meta/, frontmatter on all files, .gitignore updated, DRAFT_CURSOR_RULE.md present
expectations: wiki_orderbot/00_BOOT.md exists with layer L0 frontmatter
wiki_orderbot/domains/ contains at least 4 domain markdown files
wiki_orderbot/meta/AGENT_PROTOCOL.md defines max 2 domains per session
wiki_orderbot/reference/file-map.md exists with no long prose paragraphs
wiki_orderbot is added to .gitignore when user requested gitignore

evals.prompt: We already have wiki_payments/ scaffolded in this monorepo. Fill it using the standard fill order — start with reference tables from docker-compose and the payments-api router, then expand the domains.
evals.expected_output: L4 reference pages populated from code sources; domains updated with links to reference; CHANGELOG entry added; topics/README status updated
expectations: reference/env-vars.md or reference/api-endpoints.md contains values traced to repo files not invented names
domains/*.md link to reference/ pages instead of duplicating full endpoint tables
meta/CHANGELOG.md has a dated entry for the fill pass
L4 pages use tables as primary content not essay paragraphs

evals.prompt: Add a new microservice notification-svc to our existing wiki_platform. Update the wiki scaffold and MAP router — don't rewrite the whole wiki.
evals.expected_output: New domains/notifications.md (or similar), 01_MAP router row, topics/README if needed, CHANGELOG entry, minimal edits to 00_BOOT component table
expectations: 01_MAP.md domain router includes the new service domain
New domain file has YAML frontmatter with layer L2 and code_paths
Existing filled topics were not deleted or emptied
